{{Vanilla|Desert Pyramid}}
A '''desert pyramid''' generates as in vanilla. [[Matcha Flavoured]] changes its chest loot, adding [[The Avesta]], [[Raw Diamond]]s and raw gold and iron. The [[Archaeologist]] sells Desert Temple Maps at level 2.
